name: Volumetric Snapping
definition: An algorithm that constructs an interpolating triangular mesh from a closed point cloud of arbitrary genus by voxelizing an intermediate Delaunay cover, triangulating the voxel surface, and snapping vertices to the nearest point in the cloud.
summary: Volumetric Snapping constructs watertight meshes by voxelizing a Delaunay cover and snapping vertices to the point cloud, ensuring topological correctness unlike direct methods.
